scene_description: Four children are sitting around a campfire in a forest. They are roasting marshmallows on sticks over a fire pit. There is a tent in the background and camping chairs around the fire.

questions.question: What are the children holding over the fire?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the children are holding out toward the fire.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round pit in the center of the picture.

questions.question: Who is sitting in the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at all the people sitting around the fire.

questions.question: Where are the children sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall trees in the background.

questions.question: What is the big green thing behind the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big green shape behind the children on the right side.
